question: In which year did Robert Hooke introduce the term 'cell'?
solution:
The correct answer is **1665**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Robert Hooke** coined the term 'cell' in **1665** when he described the cells in cork.
 
• His observations were published in his book "**Micrographia**."
 
• Hooke used a compound microscope to observe the cell walls in cork, but he did not observe living cells.</li&
